shared_elements: concentric circle / ring with central dot (disc motif)
crouching profile figures with large curved heads, rendered in low relief outline
paired/repeated motifs arranged in horizontal registers
justification: Both surfaces carry the same distinctive combination of low-relief, heavy-outlined crouching profile figures with large curved beaked heads placed in registers above a prominent concentric ring-and-dot disc, plus flanking crescent/arc motifs — a specific and non-obvious pairing rather than generic circles and animals. The clearest difference is that in A the motifs are laid out symmetrically and vertically as a designed composition on a shaped body (with a girdle band and arcs framing them), while in B they are scattered irregularly across an uneven natural surface with more crowding and overlap of figures.
